title: Game files
intro: Drop every debugger, result and replay file from the evening at once. AFC finds each game in them, joins a game that is split across two debugger files, pairs it with its result and replay files and suggests the match it belongs to. Nothing is saved until you press Apply.
drop: Drop debugger, result and replay files here, or click to choose
dropHint: From Free Fire_64_Data: Debugger\debugger-*.log, MatchResult_*.log, and Replays\ReplayInfo_*.bin for damage and guns. As many as you have, in any order.

file.debuggerGames: {count, plural, =0 {No games played in it} one {# game} other {# games}}
file.replay: Damage and guns of one game

noGames: No games were found in these files.

why.onRoster: {on} of {total} players are on this event's rosters.
why.paired: Paired with its result file by the game's own match id.
why.agree: The two files agree on every team and every player.

notes.joined: Joined from {count} debugger files: the observer client was away for {seconds} seconds of this game. Kills in that gap come from the result file; knocks there are missing.
notes.notEnded: The debugger stops before this game ended, so the game has no match id.
notes.beforeEvent: Played before this event started, so it is set to "Don't use". Pick a match if it is one.
notes.afterEvent: Played after this event ended, so it is set to "Don't use". Pick a match if it is one.
notes.notOnRoster: Only {on} of {total} players are on this event's rosters, probably another room. It is set to "Don't use" until you pick a match.
notes.noResult: Kills, knocks and the kill feed come from the debugger. The debugger cannot tell placement, so give each team its placement.
notes.alreadySaved: This game is already saved on that match. Applying again replaces it with the same game.
notes.captureReader: Read with AFC Capture's own reader: every stat Capture sends is saved for this game.
notes.placementsFromLog: The places below come from the order teams were wiped in the log. Check them, change any that are wrong, or add the result file.

cmp.partial: The debugger saw {dbg} of the {res} kills: it missed part of this game.
cmp.counted: The two files count these kills differently.

summary.games: {count, plural, =0 {No game is set to a match.} one {# game goes to its match.} other {# games go to their matches.}}
summary.debuggerOnly: {count, plural, one {# from the debugger only.} other {# from the debugger only.}}
summary.notUsed: {count, plural, one {# not used.} other {# not used.}}

done.game: Saved: {players} players credited, {flags} flagged, {events} kills and knocks in the kill feed.
done.all: {count, plural, one {# game saved.} other {# games saved.}}
done.damage: {count, plural, one {Damage for # player.} other {Damage for # players.}}

errors.twice: Two games are set to the same match. Pick another match or "Don't use".
errors.placements: Give every team in game {n} its placement, each place once.

missing.title: Still needed for this game:
missing.debugger: knocks, revives, grenades, gloo walls, medkits and the kill feed
missing.result: the game's official placements and kills
missing.replay: every player's damage and the gun of every kill and knock

handOver.moved: That is a game log, not a result file. It was added to Game files above, which reads it like AFC Capture.
handOver.openBox: That is a game log, not a result file. Open Game files: it is waiting there.
handOver.hint: The game's MatchResult file (.log or .txt). A debugger log or replay goes to Game files.
